title: Rate-Limited Web Page Fetcher
scenario: Build an isolated, rate-limited web page fetcher for a documentation indexing service. Each rate limiter and crawler instance must own its own quota, deduplication, and cancellation state while bounding concurrency, preserving error causes, and cleaning up abort listeners.

milestones.title: Contracts, Errors & URL Normalization
milestones.goal: Define typed crawler contracts, CrawlerError with preserved cause, and pure normalizeUrls deduplication without input mutation.

examples.explanation: Whitespace is trimmed and duplicate URLs keep only their first occurrence.

examples.call: (() => { const err = new CrawlerError('FETCH_FAILED', 'Gateway timeout'); return { name: err.name, code: err.code, isError: err instanceof Error }; })()

milestones.title: Closure-Scoped Rate Limiter
milestones.goal: Implement createRateLimiter with strictly instance-owned sliding-window state and injectable clock/sleep.

examples.input: limiter = createRateLimiter({ maxPerWindow: 3, windowMs: 200, now, sleep }); await limiter.acquire(); await limiter.acquire()
examples.explanation: Two acquisitions fit within maxPerWindow = 3 without waiting.
examples.call: (() => { let clock = 0; let sleepCalls = 0; const limiter = createRateLimiter({ maxPerWindow: 3, windowMs: 200, now: () => clock, sleep: async (ms) => { sleepCalls += 1; clock += ms; } }); return limiter.acquire().then(() => limiter.acquire()).then(() => ({ sleepCalls, clock })); })()

examples.input: limiter = createRateLimiter({ maxPerWindow: 1, windowMs: 120, now, sleep }); await limiter.acquire(); await limiter.acquire()
examples.explanation: The second call waits 120 ms for the first slot to leave the window.
examples.call: (() => { let clock = 0; const sleepDurations = []; const limiter = createRateLimiter({ maxPerWindow: 1, windowMs: 120, now: () => clock, sleep: async (ms) => { sleepDurations.push(ms); clock += ms; } }); return limiter.acquire().then(() => limiter.acquire()).then(() => ({ sleepDurations, clock })); })()

constraints: windowMs is a positive finite number > 0

milestones.title: Bounded Concurrent Page Crawler
milestones.goal: Implement createPageCrawler with per-crawl deduplication, bounded concurrency, rate limiter integration, and error preservation.

examples.call: createPageCrawler(async (url) => ({ url, status: 200, title: 'OK' }), { concurrency: 2 }).crawl(['https://guide.example.org/home', 'https://guide.example.org/faq']).then((r) => ({ succeeded: r.succeeded, failed: r.failed, aborted: r.aborted, urls: r.results.map((x) => x.url) }))

examples.explanation: Duplicate seeds are collapsed into a single fetch.
examples.call: createPageCrawler(async (url) => ({ url, status: 200, title: 'Page' }), { concurrency: 2 }).crawl(['https://guide.example.org/a', ' https://guide.example.org/a ', 'https://guide.example.org/b']).then((r) => ({ succeeded: r.succeeded, failed: r.failed, totalResults: r.results.length }))

milestones.title: AbortSignal Cancellation & Listener Cleanup
milestones.goal: Cancel queued work cleanly on AbortSignal, preserve started fetch outcomes, and detach abort listeners after settlement.

examples.call: (() => { const ac = new AbortController(); return createPageCrawler(async (url) => ({ url, status: 200, title: 'OK' }), { concurrency: 2 }).crawl(['https://guide.example.org/p1', 'https://guide.example.org/p2'], { signal: ac.signal }).then((r) => ({ succeeded: r.succeeded, failed: r.failed, aborted: r.aborted })); })()

examples.input: Abort controller during the first fetch with concurrency 1 over two URLs
examples.output: { aborted: true, firstOk: true, secondAborted: true }
examples.explanation: The in-flight fetch finishes while the queued URL is marked aborted.
examples.call: (() => { const ac = new AbortController(); return createPageCrawler(async (url) => { if (url.endsWith('/one')) ac.abort(new Error('cancel')); return { url, status: 200, title: 'OK' }; }, { concurrency: 1 }).crawl(['https://guide.example.org/one', 'https://guide.example.org/two'], { signal: ac.signal }).then((r) => ({ aborted: r.aborted, firstOk: r.results[0].ok, secondAborted: r.results[1].aborted })); })()

review.note: No leaks, distinct realistic domain, valid PRG-T01-C01 units/traps, clean _reference Layer 3, and package.json check:hidden now passes all 8 hidden tests with LAB_SRC_DIR=../src.
